title: Write 4 optional archetype descriptions for PLAYER_PITCH_AND_PRINCIPLES.md
description:
From GitHub issue #58 — the 6 core archetype descriptions and player principles are complete (see PR #219). Remaining: Trickster, Crafter, Sentinel, and Healer descriptions in the same present-tense psychological framing used for the 6 core archetypes.

## Constraints (same as core archetypes)
- Present-tense psychological framing only: current method + role function + gift + doubt
- No fallen-godhood hints, no past-power framing, no cosmic mystery language
- Must pass the same test: describes who this person IS, not who they were

## Blocked on
These archetypes are listed as 'design skeletons only' in lat.md/characters.md. Do not write descriptions until the archetype designs are play-ready. The Surrendered-Layer Framework (Decision 10) must be locked first — Sentinel has an unresolved tool conflict (recording device vs. cracked lantern).

## When ready
Add to both versions:
- narrative/sessions/00_session0/PLAYER_PITCH_AND_PRINCIPLES.md (player-facing section)
- narrative/sessions/00_session0/gm_secrets/PLAYER_PITCH_AND_PRINCIPLES_GM.md (cosmological context per archetype)
notes: Also needs discussion before finalizing: language in the player-facing doc regarding the setting's real-world analog nature. The world uses Silk Road cultural anchors (Decision 14: 6 priority ancestries renamed with Silk Road references). The pitch and archetype descriptions currently use neutral/generic fantasy register — worth a conversation about how explicitly to signal the Central Asian / Silk Road heritage to players, and whether any of the current phrasing undersells or misrepresents the setting's cultural specificity.
